issues.detail: Verify actual Siemens references and setting ranges; 3RU2/3RU11 depictions and 3RU1116-0AB0 may not match teaching 3.5–5 A range. Do not present them as manufacturer-equivalent.

Review normal-state NC symbols, F1/F2/S0/S1/KM1 path, PE, protective coordination, ambiguous F2 scale and A2 marking. NC belongs to pair95–96 and NO to pair97–98, not each individual terminal. No asserted luminous TRIP function or exact trip time.
Clamp intended around one L1 conductor. Physical continuity and safe real measurement setup require human validation; no L2/L3 readings inferred.
Continuity shown only after DEC-02-A; before selection, stage2 declares isolation, verified absence of voltage and elimination of parallel paths. Image itself does not prove these conditions.
Wear alone does not prove seizure; interpret with the authored authorized mechanical record after machine lockout.
User should confirm these exact supplied files correspond to approved visual versions; originals preserved without inferring identity from prior-chat labels.
